messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Stan Segfault
parts:
On Friday, March 17, 2017 at 10:50:23 AM UTC-4, David Manheim wrote:
It happened again - so how can I fix it?

I may not be able to recompile stan on the server I am using due to permissions; is there a different approach? Can I perhaps use a different version of Rcpp - and if so, which version does Rstan use?

It uses whatever version of Rcpp is on the server. But with Ubuntu servers, sometimes core packages are installed as binaries from the official repositories, i.e. r-cran-rcpp, in which case Rcpp was compiled with whatever setting were used in the repositories. If you have StanHeaders, rstan, etc. installed in your home directory on the server, it would usually be possible to install Rcpp there as well, in which case it would use the version in your home directory rather than the global one.

Ben
